daily_summary: 当日变更涵盖性能优化、bugfix、重构和新功能多个方向。性能方面包括：为 batch-invariant persistent matmul 添加按架构（Ada/Hopper）调优的配置（decode kernel 最高 ~3x 加速）、BGE-M3 同步 pooling 吞吐提升（将 prompt token IDs 移至 CPU 存储并缓存 PoolingCursor 状态）、Model Runner V2 的 CUDA graph 内存预留机制（profiling 阶段采样外推 FULL graph 内存占用）。Bugfix 方面包括：Kimi K3 KDA 在 CUDA graph profiling 时跳过缺失 metadata、FlashAttention metadata 改用 group geometry（修复 spec decode 场景）、DCP 稀疏 MLA metadata 处理、DCP slot mapping 的 kernel block size 处理、worker RPC payload 释放、run_batch 上传重试逻辑修复、packed weight transfer 的 CUDA stream 复用。重构方面包括：run_batch.py 从 openai 目录移至 launchers 目录（旧路径保留 deprecation shim）、Kimi K3 的 UnfinalizedMoEOutput proto 类型标注。新功能方面包括：Cohere ChatV2 render endpoint、Muse-Glimmer LoRA 多模态模块映射。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日变更对 vllm-ascend 的主要影响集中在三处：(1) GPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache 新增 is_profiling 参数、profile_cudagraph_memory 从返回 0 变为执行 CUDA 特定 profiling，NPUModelRunnerV2 继承 GPUModelRunner 需关注此行为变化并确保覆写兼容；(2) PoolingMetadata 接口变更，prompt_token_ids 恒为 None，pooling 方法需改用 prompt_token_ids_cpu，影响 Ascend 的 pooling 路径（如 AscendInputBatch 或自定义 pooler）；(3) MLAAttention DCP combine 的稀疏 MLA metadata 修复，影响 Ascend MLA+DCP 共享代码路径。其余变更（matmul 调优、Kimi K3、FlashAttention、前端重构、multiproc executor、weight transfer、Cohere API 等）对 Ascend 无影响。

commits.comment: 为 batch-invariant persistent matmul 添加按 GPU 架构调优的配置。新增 batch_invariant_configs.py，为 Ada（RTX 4090D）和 Hopper（H20）架构定义了常见 (N, K) 形状下的 block_m/block_n/num_warps/num_stages 配置，并按 M 分桶（m_buckets）。_get_matmul_config 根据 M/N/K/dtype 选择配置，非 bf16 或不支持的架构回退到默认配置。resolve_tuned_matmul_configs() 在 init_batch_invariance 时调用，通过 current_platform.is_cuda() 判断架构族。测试验证了 tuned M buckets 下的 batch invariance。实现方式合理，配置表按架构隔离，回退路径安全。

commits.comment: 为 Model Runner V2 添加 CUDA graph 内存预留机制。新增 profile_cudagraph_memory()：在 memory profiling 阶段（真实 KV cache 分配前）bootstrap 最小 KV cache，将 FULL graph 捕获限制为最大的 N 个（_FULL_GRAPH_PROFILING_SAMPLES=2）到 throwaway pool，通过采样内存增量外推总 FULL 成本，然后 teardown 释放所有 profiling 状态。initialize_kv_cache 新增 is_profiling 参数（跳过 KV connector 初始化）。同时修复 mamba/GDN 层在 profiling dummy run 时缺失 metadata 的崩溃（改用 .get() + None 检查）。测试覆盖 profiling 控制流、外推逻辑、错误清理、compilation counter 恢复等。

ascend_impact.functionality: GPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache 新增 is_profiling 参数（默认 False，向后兼容）；profile_cudagraph_memory 从返回 0 变为执行真实的 CUDA graph 内存 profiling（依赖 CUDAGraphWrapper、BreakableCUDAGraphWrapper、torch.accelerator 等 CUDA 特定 API）。NPUModelRunnerV2 继承 GPUModelRunner，若未覆写 profile_cudagraph_memory，在 NPU 上调用会执行 CUDA 特定代码路径。initialize_kv_cache 的 is_profiling 参数需要 Ascend 覆写版本兼容（若 Ascend 覆写签名不含该参数，profiling 调用会失败）。mamba/GDN 层的 metadata .get() 变更为共享 bugfix，Ascend 的 mamba 相关实现同步受益。

[Model Runner V2] Reserve CUDA graph memory (#53306)

Signed-off-by: Anh Tran <anh.tran.3889@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Nick Hill <nickhill123@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Anh Tran <anh.tran.3889@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: anhtra3889 <anhtra@nvidia.com>

affected_interfaces: NPUModelRunner (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py) - inherits GPUModelRunner.profile_cudagraph_memory(), which this commit changes from a 'return 0' stub into a real CUDA-graph memory-profiling implementation, and inherits the modified GPUModelRunner.execute_model() (mamba-group filtering during dummy+profile runs) and the new initialize_kv_cache(is_profiling=...) base signature

ModelAclGraphManager (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/aclgraph_utils.py) - subclasses ModelCudaGraphManager/CudaGraphManager; new profiling hooks (_max_full_descs_to_capture, _capture_mem_samples) and the profile_cudagraph_memory() flow assume CUDA graphs (torch.cuda.graph, set_graph_pool_id, CUDAGraphWrapper, torch.accelerator.get_memory_info), which are NPU-unsafe if the inherited path is ever invoked

vllm_ascend/ops/gdn.py (AscendGatedDeltaNetAttention._forward_core, ~line 277) - still does attn_metadata[self.prefix] (KeyError on missing mamba metadata), unlike upstream mamba layers now guarded with .get()/None-check
vllm_ascend/_310p/ops/fla/gdn_310.py (~line 217) - direct attn_metadata[self.prefix] indexing, same gap

NPUWorker (vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py) - determine_available_memory()/compile_or_warm_up_model() manage graph memory via measured capture_model() npugraph_memory_bytes and never call profile_cudagraph_memory(); must stay that way or override it
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit makes GPUModelRunner.profile_cudagraph_memory() (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py:835) call the new CUDA-only _profile_cudagraph_memory() (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/cudagraph_utils.py), adds is_profiling=False to initialize_kv_cache() (uses ModelCudaGraphManager + NO_OP_KV_CONNECTOR), and filters MambaSpec attn_groups out of prepare_attn during dummy+profile runs; upstream mamba layers were hardened with .get(self.prefix)/None guards. On Ascend the new path is not exercised (NPUWorker extends WorkerBase and overrides determine_available_memory, never calling profile_cudagraph_memory), so nothing breaks immediately, but defensive adaptation is required: 1) In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py, override profile_cudagraph_memory() to return 0 (or implement an ACL-graph-based estimate) so the inherited CUDA-specific implementation (which builds a CUDA ModelCudaGraphManager, uses torch.cuda.graph/set_graph_pool_id/CUDAGraphWrapper) can never run on NPU if upstream later calls it from a shared worker path; 2) if adopting the new profiling flow, ensure initialize_kv_cache(is_profiling=True) runs under graph_manager_wrapper so an ACL graph manager is created and the kv_connector stays no-op; 3) add the same .get(self.prefix)/None-guard to vllm_ascend/ops/gdn.py (_forward_core), vllm_ascend/ops/bailing_moe_linear_attn.py, and vllm_ascend/_310p/ops/fla/gdn_310.py so missing mamba metadata (as produced by the new execute_model MambaSpec filtering) falls back to the warmup path instead of KeyError; 4) verify Ascend profile_run/compile_or_warm_up_model still reserve ACL graph memory via measured npugraph_memory_bytes (unchanged). No changes needed to NPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache override signature (base change is backward compatible).
deep_analysis.risk: Low immediate risk: the new CUDA-graph memory reservation is inactive on Ascend (NPUWorker does not call profile_cudagraph_memory; profile_run dummy runs use skip_attn=True so the new MambaSpec filtering in execute_model is not reached), and all signature changes are backward-compatible. Medium/latent risk: NPUModelRunner now inherits a CUDA-only profile_cudagraph_memory() that would fail or mis-reserve memory if ever invoked (e.g. if vllm-ascend tracks upstream and starts using the GPUWorker memory flow); and the metadata-missing pattern introduced by the commit is not yet mirrored in vllm-ascend's own GDN/Bailing/310p op layers, which would KeyError on attn_metadata[self.prefix] if a dummy+profile run builds attention metadata on NPU. No model-output/accuracy impact.

commits.comment: 在完全下载远程媒体之前拒绝超限响应，防止 OOM DoS 攻击。主要变更：(1) 新增 `VLLM_MAX_MEDIA_DOWNLOAD_SIZE_MB` 环境变量（默认 256MB）；(2) `HTTPConnection.get_bytes/async_get_bytes` 新增 `max_bytes` 参数，通过流式读取（64KB chunk）和 Content-Length 预检查来限制响应大小，避免将整个响应体加载到内存；(3) 新增 `HTTPResponseSizeExceededError` 和 `MediaDownloadSizeExceededError` 异常；(4) `MediaIO` 基类新增 `get_max_bytes()` 方法，音频 IO 实现 25MB 限制并在 base64 解码前检查编码大小；(5) 将音频文件大小检查从 serving 层提前到媒体加载层。该变更涉及平台无关的 HTTP 连接层和多模态媒体处理，所有平台（包括 Ascend）都会继承新的下载限制。

ascend_impact.functionality: 新增 `VLLM_MAX_MEDIA_DOWNLOAD_SIZE_MB`（默认 256MB）限制远程媒体下载大小，`HTTPConnection.get_bytes/async_get_bytes` 新增 `max_bytes` 参数并改为流式读取。该变更位于平台无关的 HTTP 连接层和多模态媒体处理层，vllm-ascend 的多模态输入处理会自动继承此限制。`MediaIO.get_max_bytes()` 新增到基类，默认返回 None，现有子类不受影响。音频文件大小检查从 serving 层提前到媒体加载层（`AudioMediaIO.load_bytes/load_base64`），行为变化对所有平台一致。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。变更位于平台无关层，vllm-ascend 无需修改测试。

commits.comment: 新增 sharded RDT（Ray Direct Transport）权重同步后端，用于 RL 训练中大规模 MoE 模型的 P2P 权重传输。核心设计：(1) 拉取式（pull-based）：每个推理 worker 只拉取自己在张量/专家并行下消费的切片，而非广播整个模型；(2) bake 阶段通过 `FakeRDTTensor` 拦截模型 `load_weights`，记录每个目标切片的 op chain 和 as_strided 目标区域，生成静态重放计划；(3) 按 decoder layer 分组（`layerwise_groups`），逐层 gather/publish/pull/free，通过 `gather_lookahead` 控制 trainer 端驻留内存；(4) `WeightSource` 新增 `held_names()`/`groups()`/`iter_groups()` 支持部分所有权（pipeline stage、expert parallelism）；(5) `WeightTransferEngine` 新增 `defers_processing`/`drain_pending` 支持异步后处理；(6) RayExecutorV2 为 sharded_rdt 后端启用 `enable_tensor_transport`。该后端要求 Ray >= 2.56、NIXL、`distributed_executor_backend="ray"`，且不支持 EPLB。变更涉及 `vllm/distributed/weight_transfer/`（架构上下文中标记为 Ascend 不使用）和 Ray executor，对 Ascend 无影响。
